name: Farmer's Walk
research: Two moments of a short walking step (double support). Root lowered 0.02 m (rest 0.971 -> 0.951), so hip joints sit at z ~0.954. Picture 1: left foot forward and flat, ankle (0.12, -0.15, 0.074) = 0.155 m in front of the hip (hip y 0.005); hip-ankle distance sqrt(0.155^2 + 0.88^2) = 0.894 m vs 0.90 leg -> knee ~13 deg. Right foot behind on its ball: ankle 0.165 m behind the hip; heel up 15 deg (rot X +15 = toes down): ball offset from ankle (0, -0.14, -0.06) turns to z -0.094, so ankle z = 0.014 + 0.094 = 0.108; hip-ankle sqrt(0.165^2 + 0.846^2) = 0.862 -> cos rule 0.862^2 = 2(0.45^2)(1 - cos k) -> knee ~33-36 deg. Step 0.32 m. Picture 2 swaps the legs. Arms straight, elev 10 out to the side (fist ~0.32 m from the midline so the neutral-grip plates, radius 0.088, clear the thighs at x ~0.20), elbow 5, palms in; right arm mirrors. Trunk upright, shoulders level. S2 McGill 2013 (split load, spine), S1 McGill 2009 (farmer's walk EMG), S3 ACE. Facts: research/farmers_walk.json.
